name: Mixed Feelings: While You Were Away
source:
Gale and Arthur have been dating since high school. But after graduation, Arthur moved away to go to college. Long-distance relationship was hard on both, and Gale found himself feeling lonely without his partner nearby. One day, when he applied to work at a cafe, he met a charismatic man named Brycen. The two clicked and soon found themselves attracted to each other. Even though Gale started to develop feelings for Brycen, he still loves his boyfriend. But deep down, he knew he shouldn't love both.

So, who will Gale end up choosing? His gentle and caring boyfriend or his playful yet sweet co-worker?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1900400/]Steam[/url]]
